items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Market Damaged, Big Winners Broken; Apple, Amazon, Microsoft Strong
items.summary: The stock market needs repair while Sandisk and Micron seem broken. Apple, Amazon and Microsoft are holding up. Berkshire earnings fell.

items.title: How to invest in AI amid AI spending worries?
items.summary: Investing.com -- Investors should spread their artificial intelligence exposure beyond a handful of technology giants as mounting capital expenditure raises questions about returns, according to UBS strategist Matthew Carter, who remains positive on AI’s contribution to global equities in 2027.

items.title: Is DoorDash (DASH) Undervalued Following Its New Lyft Partnership?
items.summary: DoorDash (DASH) is back in focus after Lyft announced Lyft Go, a new membership that links directly with DashPass and lets riders earn credits redeemable for both rides and DoorDash orders. Set against this new Lyft tie-up, DoorDash’s share price has eased in recent months, with a 30 day share price return of down 6.05% and a 90 day move down 16.92%, even as the 3 year total shareholder return of 105.41% points to strong longer term momentum. That momentum is now cooling as investors weigh...

items.title: He Loses His Job at 62 as Amazon Cuts 95 More Positions. He Claims Social Security to Get By, Then Faces an $8,400 Bill to Undo It
items.summary: Social Security offers one rare do-over for people who claim too early, but the clock is ticking and the price of erasing the decision climbs every month. Before a laid-off worker uses it, he should weigh a cheaper alternative.

items.title: Amazon Prime members' new Uber Eats perk comes with a $25 minimum
items.summary: Prime members can skip the delivery fee on qualifying Uber Eats orders of $25 or more. The switch comes as Walmart bundles Walmart+ and Sam’s Club Plus for $120 a year.

items.title: Walton Family Gets $100 Billion Richer As Walmart Surges
items.summary: Among the world's wealthiest people, they are the only ones who never founded or ran a company, yet their fortunes are climbing while tech titans slide. What explains the Waltons' remarkable 2026 run?

items.title: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
items.summary: Apple and Meta’s objections mean all seven of the biggest U.S. tech companies have now asked to keep their shares off the planned OKX-ICE venue.

items.title: America Just Matched a 57-Year Employment Record. Why Are Workers Still Worried?
items.summary: Layoffs have nearly vanished, yet consumer sentiment sits at recession levels. A labor market that shields those with jobs while shutting out those seeking one may be setting up the holiday quarter and the Fed for an unexpected collision.
